current.text: Fox is projected to start in the backcourt with Stephon Castle. Reports say the team still has a lot of faith in him.
The rest of the starting lineup is unclear. Dylan Harper may start next to Castle and Fox, which would make it a three-guard lineup.
He often starts possessions off the ball. Castle runs the offense and Fox is used as a second option.
The Spurs stagger their three guards so that at least two are always on the floor. Castle, Harper and Fox cannot all get bigger roles.
Experts expect Harper to play more, and Fox could lose on-ball time to him.

He came back from a serious high ankle sprain in the Minnesota series after about 10 days and was clearly not himself. He lost his downhill burst, and the Spurs offense relies on downhill guard penetration.
He should be healthier this season. A healthy Fox is called the key ceiling raiser for the Spurs.

Experts doubt he improves on last season or repeats 19 points, 4 rebounds and 6 assists. They do not see a top 50 player. One expert would not rule out a finish around rank 43 to 45 but will not take that risk.
The newest calls say he costs too much at his current draft spot. He is too high at rank 70, early at 61, and experts would not draft him there.
The Spurs are projected to be a top team in the West. One expert predicts 63 wins.

durable.text: He had hamstring problems in 2025-26 and a serious high ankle sprain in that season's playoffs.

note: Fox is a balanced guard with no weak category. Assists (5.6) and steals (1.4) are his best categories, so he fits any build, but nothing about him is elite. The newest expert calls say his rank of 53 to 70 assumes the best case. Our league paid 21 USD for him last season. Yahoo's average cost of 4.3 USD and ESPN's of 10.2 USD point to a fair price of about 5 to 10 USD, so let others pay more. Early in the season, check his Yahoo questionable status, whether Harper starts next to him and Castle, and whether his downhill burst is back.
